note: v2124: The vault classifier gave a different answer once the item had been filed, because the white base branch is gated on the extras table and the vault register writes the name straight into it. Measured on his live board, five of seven bases moved locker purely by being vaulted, so the assembler filed with one answer and the integrity auditor, which calls the same function afterwards, got another and flagged the systems own filing as a misroute. A vault entry records that he has one, not that the name is a catalogue unique.
